original_test_intent: Verify the active retimer firmware for the intended GPU interconnect topology matches the project-approved release package.
original_method: Use a trusted read-only Redfish channel to retrieve exact retimer_active, confirm unique retimer scope/active state, and compare its version with the authoritative release entry using redacted evidence.
manual_activity: Firmware/security engineers provide topology and release authority, review version/security discrepancies and own the verdict.
required_inputs: Brokered read-only credential and network ACL
safety_requirements: Use least privilege and exact inventory scope
Confirm retimer count/member/active state against topology
Stop on trust/auth/missing/duplicate/malformed or audit error
Do not expose credentials or call update/reset
agent_execution_scope: GET only the authorized retimer active member
Compare each required retimer scope to supplied release policy
Do not broaden inventory, bypass TLS, mutate firmware or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve BMC trust and retimer topology/member mapping
Resolve missing/duplicate/mismatch/security issues and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A broad insecure list cannot prove the intended retimer topology or active member and mishandles secrets.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Query exact retimer_active through verified HTTPS and brokered read-only access, then compare its topology-bound active version to the approved release.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Retimer active firmware comparison and source 5/5 timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce one traceable result per required retimer/member or an approved aggregate member with topology identity, active status, version and release expectation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Secures access and prevents inactive/wrong-component matches.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: RMI or IFWI versions do not satisfy retimer firmware coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A single aggregate Redfish member may represent multiple physical retimers; project schema must define completeness.

project_override_considerations: A secure vendor retimer query may replace Redfish only with explicit topology/completeness and active-version equivalence; no firmware update is authorized.
expected_evidence: Exact retimer_active URI/status/time and redacted fields
Retimer topology/member count and active-state mapping

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and retimer_active path consistently target retimer firmware; topology/completeness is a required input rather than competing intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Trusted access, topology mapping and release target can be supplied; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Turns an unsafe generic firmware list into a topology-aware, trusted active-retimer version assertion with explicit completeness.
independent_technical_reasoning: A platform can contain several retimers, and an inventory member may be aggregate or per-device. One version string cannot prove complete topology coverage unless the project mapping says so. The evidence therefore joins physical scope, active member and release policy while protecting management credentials.
